shlokas.text: उत्पादकं यत् प्रवदन्ति बुद्धेर् अधिष्ठितं सत् पुरुषेण सांख्याः । व्यक्तस्य कृत्स्नस्य तदेकबीजम् अव्यक्तमीशं गणितं च चन्दे
shlokas.english: I bow to the Unmanifest Lord (Īśvara), who is the sole seed of the entire manifest universe—which the Sāṁkhya philosophers declare to be produced from Intellect (Buddhi) when presided over by Spirit (Puruṣa)—and I bow to Algebra (Avyakta-Gaṇita / Bījagaṇita), which is the single seed and foundation of all manifest mathematics (Vyakta-Gaṇita / Arithmetic).
shlokas.hindi: सांख्य दर्शन के विद्वान जिस अव्यक्त (प्रकृति) को पुरुष द्वारा अधिष्ठित होकर बुद्धि का उत्पादक मानते हैं, जो संपूर्ण व्यक्त जगत् का एकमात्र मूल कारण (बीज) है, उस अव्यक्त ईश्वर को तथा संपूर्ण व्यक्त गणित (अंकगणित) के एकमात्र मूल कारण अव्यक्त गणित (बीजगणित) को मैं प्रणाम करता हूँ।
shlokas.english_draft: I bow to the Unmanifest Lord (Īśvara), who is the sole seed of the entire manifest universe—which the Sāṁkhya philosophers declare to be produced from Intellect (Buddhi) when presided over by Spirit (Puruṣa)—and I bow to Algebra (Avyakta-Gaṇita / Bījagaṇita), which is the single seed and foundation of all manifest mathematics (Vyakta-Gaṇita / Arithmetic).

shlokas.text: पूर्व प्रोक्तं व्यक्तमव्यक्तबीजं प्रायः प्रश्नी नो विनाऽव्यक्तयुक्त्या। ज्ञातुं शक्या मन्दधीभिनितान्तं यस्मात् तस्माद् वच्मि बीजक्रियां च
shlokas.english: The arithmetic (Vyakta-Gaṇita) explained earlier has algebra (Avyakta-Gaṇita) as its seed. Since mathematical problems can rarely be solved by persons of dull intellect without the methods of algebra, I shall therefore explain algebraic operations (Bīja-kriyā).
shlokas.hindi: पूर्व में कहा गया व्यक्त गणित (अंकगणित) अव्यक्त गणित (बीजगणित) रूपी बीज से ही उत्पन्न हुआ है। चूँकि मन्द बुद्धि वाले व्यक्तियों द्वारा बीजगणितीय युक्तियों के बिना गणितीय प्रश्नों को हल कर पाना प्रायः सर्वथा असंभव है, इसलिए मैं बीजगणितीय क्रियाओं (बीजक्रिया) का वर्णन करता हूँ।
shlokas.english_draft: The arithmetic (Vyakta-Gaṇita) explained earlier has algebra (Avyakta-Gaṇita) as its seed. Since mathematical problems can rarely be solved by persons of dull intellect without the methods of algebra, I shall therefore explain algebraic operations (Bīja-kriyā).

shlokas.text: योगे युतिः स्यात् क्षययोः स्वयोर् वा धनर्णयोरन्तरमेय योगः
shlokas.english: In addition, the sum of two positive numbers or of two negative numbers is their addition. But the sum of a positive and a negative number is their difference (their sum is measured by the difference between them).
shlokas.hindi: योग (जोड़) की क्रिया में दो धनात्मक (स्व) अथवा दो ऋणात्मक (क्षय/ऋण) राशियों का योग उनका जोड़ ही होता है। किंतु एक धनात्मक और एक ऋणात्मक राशि का योग उनके अंतर (अंतरफल) के बराबर होता है।
shlokas.english_draft: In addition, the sum of two positive numbers or of two negative numbers is their addition. But the sum of a positive and a negative number is their difference (their sum is measured by the difference between them).

shlokas.text: धनं धनेनर्णमृणेन निघ्नं द्वयं त्रयेण स्वमणेन किं स्यात
shlokas.english: A positive multiplied by a positive and a negative multiplied by a negative yield a positive product. What is the result when two and three, positive and negative respectively, are multiplied?
shlokas.hindi: धनात्मक राशि का धनात्मक से गुणा करने पर तथा ऋणात्मक राशि का ऋणात्मक से गुणा करने पर धनात्मक (स्व) फल प्राप्त होता है। इसी प्रकार जब धनात्मक/ऋणात्मक दो और तीन को आपस में गुणा किया जाता है, तो फल क्या होगा?
shlokas.english_draft: A positive multiplied by a positive and a negative multiplied by a negative yield a positive product. What is the result when two and three, positive and negative respectively, are multiplied?

shlokas.text: रूपाष्टकं रूपचतुष्टयेन धनं धनेनर्णमृणेन भक्तम् । ऋणं धनेन स्वमृणेन किं स्याद् द्रुतं वदेदं यदि बोबधीपि
shlokas.english: Eight units divided by four units: positive by positive, and negative by negative; also negative by positive, and positive by negative—tell me quickly what these results are, if you are well-versed in mathematics.
shlokas.hindi: आठ इकाई (रूप) को चार इकाई से भाग देने पर: धन का धन से, ऋण का ऋण से, ऋण का धन से और धन का ऋण से भागफल क्या होगा? हे गणितज्ञ, यदि तुम गणित क्रिया में निपुण हो तोइसे शीघ्र बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: Eight units divided by four units: positive by positive, and negative by negative; also negative by positive, and positive by negative—tell me quickly what these results are, if you are well-versed in mathematics.

shlokas.text: कृतिः स्वर्णयोः स्वं स्वमूले धनौँ । न मूलं क्षयस्यास्ति तस्याकृतित्वात्
shlokas.english: The square of both a positive and a negative quantity is positive. The square roots of a positive quantity are both positive and negative (±). There is no square root of a negative quantity, because it is not a square.
shlokas.hindi: धनात्मक तथा ऋणात्मक दोनों ही राशियों का वर्ग धनात्मक (स्व) होता है। धनात्मक राशि के वर्गमूल धनात्मक और ऋणात्मक (±) दोनों होते हैं। ऋणात्मक राशि का कोई वर्गमूल नहीं होता, क्योंकि वह किसी भी राशि का वर्ग नहीं है।
shlokas.english_draft: The square of both a positive and a negative quantity is positive. The square roots of a positive quantity are both positive and negative (±). There is no square root of a negative quantity, because it is not a square.

shlokas.text: धनस्य रूपत्रितयस्य वर्ग क्षयस्य च बेहि सखे ममाऽऽशु
shlokas.english: O friend, tell me quickly the square of positive three units, and also the square of negative three units.
shlokas.hindi: हे मित्र! धनात्मक तीन इकाई का वर्ग तथा ऋणात्मक तीन इकाई का वर्ग मुझे शीघ्र बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: O friend, tell me quickly the square of positive three units, and also the square of negative three units.

shlokas.text: खयोगे वियोगे धनर्ण तथैव च्युतं शून्यतस्तद्विपर्यासमेति
shlokas.english: In addition of zero or subtraction of zero, a positive or negative quantity remains unchanged. But when subtracted from zero, its Rashi is reversed (positive becomes negative and negative becomes positive).
shlokas.hindi: शून्य के जोड़ने (खयोग) अथवा शून्य के घटाने (खवियोग) पर धनात्मक या ऋणात्मक राशि अपरिवर्तित रहती है। किंतु जब किसी राशि को शून्य में से घटाया जाता है, तो उसका चिह्न विपरीत हो जाता है (धनात्मक ऋणात्मक और ऋणात्मक धनात्मक बन जाता है)।
shlokas.english_draft: In addition of zero or subtraction of zero, a positive or negative quantity remains unchanged. But when subtracted from zero, its sign is reversed (positive becomes negative and negative becomes positive).

shlokas.text: रूपत्रयं स्वं क्षयगं च खं च। किं स्यात् खयुक्तं वद खच्युतं च
shlokas.english: Tell me what positive three units, negative three units, and zero become when zero is added to them or subtracted from them.
shlokas.hindi: धनात्मक तीन इकाई, ऋणात्मक तीन इकाई और शून्य में शून्य जोड़ने या घटाने पर क्या परिणाम होगा, यह बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: Tell me what positive three units, negative three units, and zero become when zero is added to them or subtracted from them.

shlokas.text: द्विघ्नं त्रिहत्खं खहृतं त्रयं च शून्यस्य वर्ग वद मे पदं च
shlokas.english: Tell me zero multiplied by two, zero multiplied by three, three divided by zero (Khahara / infinity), as well as the square and square root of zero.
shlokas.hindi: शून्य को दो से गुणा करने पर, शून्य को तीन से गुणा करने पर, तीन को शून्य से भाग देने पर (खहर / अनन्त), तथा शून्य का वर्ग एवं वर्गमूल क्या होगा, मुझे बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: Tell me zero multiplied by two, zero multiplied by three, three divided by zero (Khahara / infinity), as well as the square and square root of zero.

shlokas.text: आस्मन विकारः खहरेण राशावपि प्रविष्टेष्वपि निःसतेषु। बहुष्वपि स्याल्लयसृष्टिकालेऽनन्तेऽच्युते भूतगणेषु यत्
shlokas.english: In a quantity whose denominator is zero (Khahara), no change occurs even if many quantities enter into it or issue from it; just as during cosmic dissolution (Laya) and creation (Sṛṣṭi), no change occurs in the infinite, immutable Supreme Being (Acyuta) when multitudes of beings enter into or emerge from Him.
shlokas.hindi: जिस राशि का हर शून्य हो (खहर राशि / अनन्त), उसमें अनेक राशियाँ प्रविष्ट (जोड़ी) की जाएँ या निकाली (घटाई) जाएँ, तब भी उसमें कोई विकार (परिवर्तन) नहीं होता; ठीक वैसे ही जैसे प्रलय और सृष्टि काल के समय अनंत, अविनाशी परमात्मा (अच्युत) में अनेक भूतगणों (प्राणियों) का प्रवेश या निर्गमन होने पर भी उनमें कोई विकार उत्पन्न नहीं होता।
shlokas.english_draft: In a quantity whose denominator is zero (Khahara), no change occurs even if many quantities enter into it or issue from it; just as during cosmic dissolution (Laya) and creation (Sṛṣṭi), no change occurs in the infinite, immutable Supreme Being (Acyuta) when multitudes of beings enter into or emerge from Him.

shlokas.text: यावत्तावत्कालको नीलकोऽन्यो वर्णः पीतो लोहितश्चंतदाद्याः। अव्यक्तानां कल्पिता मानसशास् तत्संख्यानं कर्तुमाचार्यवयः
shlokas.english: Yāvat-tāvat (as much as / x), Kālakā (black / y), Nīlakā (blue / z), and other colors such as Pīta (yellow) and Lohita (red) are assumed by eminent teachers as symbols for unknown quantities in order to perform computations with them.
shlokas.hindi: अज्ञात राशियों का मान और उनकी गणना करने के लिए श्रेष्ठ आचार्यों द्वारा 'यावत्तावत्' (जितना-उतना / x), 'कालक' (काला / y), 'नीलक' (नीला / z) तथा अन्य वर्ण जैसे पीत (पीला) और लोहित (लाल) आदि नाम प्रतीकों के रूप में कल्पित किए गए हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: Yāvat-tāvat (as much as / x), Kālakā (black / y), Nīlakā (blue / z), and other colors such as Pīta (yellow) and Lohita (red) are assumed by eminent teachers as symbols for unknown quantities in order to perform computations with them.

shlokas.text: योगोऽन्तरं तेषु समानजात्योर् विभिन्नजात्योश्च पृथक् स्थितिश्च
shlokas.english: Addition and subtraction of like terms (same species/variables) are performed by adding or subtracting their coefficients; while unlike terms (different species) must be kept separate.
shlokas.hindi: समान जाति (सजातीय पदों/अज्ञात राशियों) का योग और अंतर उनके गुणांकों के योग और अंतर द्वारा होता है; जबकि भिन्न जाति (विजातीय पदों) को पृथक्-पृथक् रखा जाता है।
shlokas.english_draft: Addition and subtraction of like terms (same species/variables) are performed by adding or subtracting their coefficients; while unlike terms (different species) must be kept separate.

shlokas.text: स्वमव्यक्तमेकं सखे सकरूपं धनाव्यक्तयग्मं विरूपाष्टकं च । युती पक्षयोरेतयोः किं धनणे विपर्यस्य चैक्ये भवेत् किंबदाऽऽशु
shlokas.english: O friend, tell me quickly: what is the sum of one positive unknown with positive one unit, and two positive unknowns with negative eight units? What is the sum if their Rashis are reversed?
shlokas.hindi: हे मित्र! शीघ्र बताओ: एक धनात्मक अज्ञात राशि तथा धनात्मक एक इकाई, और दो धनात्मक अज्ञात राशि तथा ऋणात्मक आठ इकाई—इन दोनों पक्षों का योग क्या होगा? और यदि इनके धनात्मक व ऋणात्मक चिह्नों को उलट दिया जाए तो योग क्या होगा?
shlokas.english_draft: O friend, tell me quickly: what is the sum of one positive unknown with positive one unit, and two positive unknowns with negative eight units? What is the sum if their signs are reversed?

shlokas.text: धनाध्यक्तयुग्माद् ऋाणाव्यक्तषटकं स्वरूपाष्टकं प्रोज्य शेषंवदाऽऽशु
shlokas.english: Subtract six negative unknowns and positive eight units from two positive unknowns, and tell me the remainder immediately.
shlokas.hindi: दो धनात्मक अज्ञात राशियों में से छह ऋणात्मक अज्ञात राशियों तथा धनात्मक आठ इकाई को घटाकर शेषफल शीघ्र बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: Subtract six negative unknowns and positive eight units from two positive unknowns, and tell me the remainder immediately.

shlokas.text: स्याद् रूपवर्णाभिहतौ तु वर्णी ब्दित्र्यादिकानां समजातिकानाम् ।। चधे तु तदर्गघनादयः स्युस तद भावितं चासमजातिघाते। भागादिकं रूपवदेव शेष व्यक्ते यदुक्तं गणिते तदत्र
shlokas.english: The product of a numerical unit and an unknown variable is a variable term. In the multiplication of two, three, or more like unknown quantities, their square, cube, etc., are produced. The product of unlike unknown quantities is called a product-term (Bhāvita). Division and other operations are performed as described in arithmetic.
shlokas.hindi: अंक (रूप) और अज्ञात राशि (वर्ण) का गुणनफल अज्ञात राशि के पद के रूप में होता है। दो, तीन आदि समान जातीय अज्ञात राशियों के परस्पर गुणा करने पर उनका वर्ग, घन आदि प्राप्त होते हैं। भिन्न जातीय अज्ञात राशियों के परस्पर गुणनफल को 'भावित' (द्विचल/बहुचल पद) कहते हैं। भाग आदि शेष क्रियाएँ अंकगणित में कहे गए नियमों के अनुसार ही होती हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: The product of a numerical unit and an unknown variable is a variable term. In the multiplication of two, three, or more like unknown quantities, their square, cube, etc., are produced. The product of unlike unknown quantities is called a product-term (Bhāvita). Division and other operations are performed as described in arithmetic.

shlokas.text: गुण्यः पृथग् गुणकखण्डसमो निवेश्यस् तैः खण्डकः महतः सहितो यथोक्त्या । अव्यक्तवर्गकरणीगुणनासु चिन्त्यो व्यक्तोक्कखण्डगुणनाविधिरेवमत्र
shlokas.english: The multiplicand is written separately as many times as there are parts of the multiplier, and multiplied by those parts, then summed according to rule. In the multiplication of unknown quantities, squares, and surds, the rules of multiplication by parts as described in arithmetic should be applied.
shlokas.hindi: गुणक के जितने खण्ड (भाग) हों, गुण्य को उतनी बार पृथक्-पृथक् लिखकर उन खण्डों से गुणा करके नियमपूर्वक योग किया जाता है। अज्ञात राशियों, वर्गों तथा करणियों के गुणा की क्रिया में अंकगणित में बताई गई खण्ड-गुणन विधि का ही उपयोग करना चाहिए।
shlokas.english_draft: The multiplicand is written separately as many times as there are parts of the multiplier, and multiplied by those parts, then summed according to rule. In the multiplication of unknown quantities, squares, and surds, the rules of multiplication by parts as described in arithmetic should be applied.

shlokas.text: यावत्तावत्पञ्चकं ब्यकरूपं यावत्तावद्भित्रिभिः सद्विरुपैः । संगुण्य द्वाग् बेहि गुण्यं गुणं वा व्यस्तं स्वर्ण कल्पयित्वा च विद्वन्
shlokas.english: O learned one, multiply five unknowns minus one unit by three unknowns plus two units; tell me quickly the product, and also find the product if the positive and negative Rashis of the multiplicand or multiplier are reversed.
shlokas.hindi: हे विद्वन्! पाँच अज्ञात राशि ऋण एक इकाई को तीन अज्ञात राशि धन दो इकाई से शीघ्र गुणा करके गुणनफल बताओ, तथा गुण्य अथवा गुणक के धन और ऋण चिह्नों को विपरीत करके भी गुणनफल बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: O learned one, multiply five unknowns minus one unit by three unknowns plus two units; tell me quickly the product, and also find the product if the positive and negative signs of the multiplicand or multiplier are reversed.

shlokas.text: भाज्याच्छेदः शुध्यति प्रच्युतः सन् स्वेषु स्वेषु स्थानकेषु क्रमेण । यर्यवर्णः संगुणो यश्च रूपैर भागाहोर लन्धयस्ताःस्युरत्र
shlokas.english: Subtracting the divisor successively from each corresponding position of the dividend, the terms in the quotient are those variables or units by which the divisor was multiplied to produce each part.
shlokas.hindi: भाज्य के अपने-अपने स्थानों से भाजक को क्रमानुसार घटाने पर, जिन-जिन अज्ञात राशियों (वर्णों) या अंकों (रूपों) से भाजक को गुणा करने पर भाज्य पद प्राप्त होते हैं, वे ही यहाँ भागफल (लब्धि) बनते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: Subtracting the divisor successively from each corresponding position of the dividend, the terms in the quotient are those variables or units by which the divisor was multiplied to produce each part.

shlokas.text: रूपैः षड्भिर्वर्जितानां चतुर्णामव्यक्तानां ब्रूहि वर्ग सखे मे
shlokas.english: O friend, tell me the square of four unknowns minus six units.
shlokas.hindi: हे मित्र! चार अज्ञात राशि ऋण छह इकाई का वर्ग मुझे बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: O friend, tell me the square of four unknowns minus six units.

shlokas.text: कृतिभ्य आदाय पदानि तेषां द्वयोर्द्वयोश्चाभिहति द्विनिघ्नीम् । शेषात् न्यजेद् रूपपदं गृहीत्वा चेल्सन्ति रूपाणि तथैव शेषम्
shlokas.english: Taking the square roots of the square terms, and subtracting twice the product of every two terms successively from the remainder; if units remain, taking their square root, and so on for the remainder—this yields the square root of the algebraic expression.
shlokas.hindi: वर्ग पदों का वर्गमूल (पद) लेकर, तथा शेषफल में से प्रत्येक दो पदों के गुणनफल का दोगुना क्रमशः घटाते हुए; यदि अंक (रूप) शेष रहें तो उनका वर्गमूल लेकर इसी प्रकार शेष प्रक्रिया करने से बीजगणितीय व्यंजक का वर्गमूल प्राप्त होता है।
shlokas.english_draft: Taking the square roots of the square terms, and subtracting twice the product of every two terms successively from the remainder; if units remain, taking their square root, and so on for the remainder—this yields the square root of the algebraic expression.

shlokas.text: कमितः क्षयगैः सहिता रहिताः कति स्युस्तेः
shlokas.english: What are the square roots of algebraic expressions when terms are accompanied by positive or negative quantities?
shlokas.hindi: जब पद धनात्मक या ऋणात्मक राशियों से युक्त या रहित हों, तो उन व्यंजकों के वर्गमूल क्या होंगे?
shlokas.english_draft: What are the square roots of algebraic expressions when terms are accompanied by positive or negative quantities?

shlokas.text: यावत्तावत्त्रयमृणमृणं कालकी नीलकः स्वं रूपेणाऽऽढया द्विगुणितमितैस्तैस्तु तैरेव निघ्नाः। किं स्यात्तेषां गुणनजफलं गण्यभक्तं च कि स्याद् गुण्यस्याथ प्रकथय कृति मूलमस्याः कृतेश्च
shlokas.english: Negative three unknowns (yāvat-tāvat), negative one black unknown (kālakā), and positive one blue unknown (nīlakā) together with one unit—tell me what results when this expression is multiplied by twice itself, what is the quotient when divided by the multiplicand, and what are its square and square root.
shlokas.hindi: ऋणात्मक तीन यावत्तावत् (x), ऋणात्मक एक कालक (y), धनात्मक एक नीलक (z) और धनात्मक एक इकाई (1)—इस व्यंजक को स्वयं के दुगुने से गुणा करने पर क्या गुणनफल होगा? गुण्य से भाग देने पर क्या भागफल होगा? तथा इस गुण्य का वर्ग और उस वर्ग का वर्गमूल क्या होगा, यह बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: Negative three unknowns (yāvat-tāvat), negative one black unknown (kālakā), and positive one blue unknown (nīlakā) together with one unit—tell me what results when this expression is multiplied by twice itself, what is the quotient when divided by the multiplicand, and what are its square and square root.

shlokas.text: योगं करण्योमहती प्रकल्प्य घातस्य मूलं द्विगुणं लघु च । योगान्तरे रूपवदेतयोस्ते वर्गण क्गे गुणयद् भजेच्च ।। लच्या हतायास्तु पदं महत्या सैकं निरेकं स्वहतं लघुघ्नम् । योगान्तरे स्तः कमशस्तयोर्वा पृथक स्थितिः स्याद् यदि नास्ति मुलम्
shlokas.english: Regarding surds (Karaṇī): take the sum of two surds as the greater surd, and twice the square root of their product as the lesser surd. Addition and subtraction of surds are performed like integers; multiplication and division are performed using their squares. If the quotient of the greater surd divided by the lesser yields a rational root, add or subtract one to/from it, square it, and multiply by the lesser surd to get their sum or difference; otherwise, they remain separate.
shlokas.hindi: करणी के नियमों में: दो करणियों के योग को बड़ी करणी (महती) तथा उनके गुणनफल के वर्गमूल के दुगुने को छोटी करणी (लघु) मानें। करणियों का योग व अंतर पूर्णांकों की भाँति होता है; तथा गुणा और भाग उनके वर्गों द्वारा किया जाता है। यदि बड़ी करणी को छोटी करणी से भाग देने पर प्राप्त लब्धि का पूर्ण वर्गमूल निकलता हो, तो उस वर्गमूल में एक जोड़कर या घटाकर, उसका वर्ग करके छोटी करणी से गुणा करने पर क्रमशः उनका योग और अंतर प्राप्त होता है; यदि वर्गमूल न निकले तो उन्हें पृथक्-पृथक् ही रखा जाता है।
shlokas.english_draft: Regarding surds (Karaṇī): take the sum of two surds as the greater surd, and twice the square root of their product as the lesser surd. Addition and subtraction of surds are performed like integers; multiplication and division are performed using their squares. If the quotient of the greater surd divided by the lesser yields a rational root, add or subtract one to/from it, square it, and multiply by the lesser surd to get their sum or difference; otherwise, they remain separate.

shlokas.text: द्विकाष्टमित्योखिभसंख्ययोश्च योगान्तरे वहि सखे करण्योः । त्रिसप्तमित्योश्च चिरं विचिन्त्य चेत् पडविधं वेत्सि सखेकरण्याः
shlokas.english: O friend, tell me the sum and difference of the surds 2 and 8, as well as of 3 and 27; after careful thought, tell me if you know the sixfold operations on surds.
shlokas.hindi: हे मित्र! 2 और 8 मान वाली करणियों का, तथा 3 और 27 मान वाली करणियों का योग और अंतर विचारपूर्वक बताओ; यदि तुम करणी की षड्विध (छह प्रकार की) क्रियाओं को जानते हो।
shlokas.english_draft: O friend, tell me the sum and difference of the surds 2 and 8, as well as of 3 and 27; after careful thought, tell me if you know the sixfold operations on surds.

shlokas.text: वधं प्रचक्ष्वाऽऽशु विपश्चरूपे गुणेऽथवा व्यर्कमिते करण्यी
shlokas.english: O wise one, state quickly the product when the multiplier is 3 minus surd 12, or surds 2, 3, 8.
shlokas.hindi: हे विद्वन्! जब गुणक 3 ऋण करणी 12 हो, अथवा करणी 2, 3, 8 हो, तो गुणनफल शीघ्र बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: O wise one, state quickly the product when the multiplier is 3 minus surd 12, or surds 2, 3, 8.

shlokas.text: क्षयो भवेच्च क्षयरूपवर्गश्चत्साध्यतेऽसौ करणीत्वहेतोः।। ऋाणात्मिकायाश्च तथा करण्या मलं क्षयो रूपविधानहेतोः
shlokas.english: If the square of a negative number is formed for the sake of surds, it is considered negative. Likewise, when extracting the root of a negative surd, the root becomes negative when converted back to a rational integer.
shlokas.hindi: यदि करणी (अपरिमेय संख्या) बनाने के उद्देश्य से किसी ऋणात्मक संख्या का वर्ग किया जाता है, तो उसे ऋणात्मक ही माना जाता है। इसी प्रकार, ऋणात्मक करणी का वर्गमूल निकालते समय, रूप (परिमेय संख्या) विधान के लिए उसका वर्गमूल ऋणात्मक होता है।
shlokas.english_draft: If the square of a negative number is formed for the sake of surds, it is considered negative. Likewise, when extracting the root of a negative surd, the root becomes negative when converted back to a rational integer.

shlokas.text: धनर्णताव्यत्ययमीप्सितायाश्छेदे करण्या असकृद विधाय। तादृक्छिदा भाज्यहरी निहन्याद् एकैव यावत् करणी हरेस्यात्।। भाज्यास्तया भाज्यगताः करण्यो लब्धाः करण्यो यदि योगजाः स्युः। विश्लेषसूत्रेण पृथक् च कायों यथा तथा प्रष्टरभीप्सिताः स्युः
shlokas.english: To divide by surds: reverse the Rashi (positive to negative or vice versa) of any desired surd in the divisor, and multiply both dividend and divisor by that expression repeatedly until only a single surd (or rational number) remains in the divisor. Then divide the surds in the dividend by it to obtain the quotient surds.
shlokas.hindi: करणी द्वारा भाग देने के लिए: हर (भाजक) में स्थित इच्छित करणी का धन-ऋण चिह्न बदलकर (अनुबद्ध करणी/conjugate बनाकर) भाज्य और हर दोनों को बार-बार तब तक गुणा करें जब तक हर में केवल एक ही करणी (या परिमेय संख्या) न रह जाए। तत्पश्चात हर से भाज्य की करणियों को भाग देकर लब्धि करणी प्राप्त करें।
shlokas.english_draft: To divide by surds: reverse the sign (positive to negative or vice versa) of any desired surd in the divisor, and multiply both dividend and divisor by that expression repeatedly until only a single surd (or rational number) remains in the divisor. Then divide the surds in the dividend by it to obtain the quotient surds.

shlokas.text: वर्गण योगकरणी विहृता विशुध्येत् खण्डानि तत्कृतिपदस्य यथेप्सितानि । कृत्वा तदीयकृतयः खलु पूर्वलन्ध्या क्षण्णा भवन्ति पृथगेवमिमाः ।करण्यः
shlokas.english: To resolve a single compound surd into separate component surds: if the compound surd is divisible by a square, divide it; break the square root of that quotient into desired rational parts, square those parts, and multiply each by the former quotient; these yield the individual component surds.
shlokas.hindi: किसी संयुक्त करणी को पृथक्-पृथक् घटक करणियों में तोड़ने के लिए: यदि संयुक्त करणी किसी वर्ग संख्या से निश्शेष विभाजित होती हो तो भाग दें; उस लब्धि के वर्गमूल के इच्छानुसार खण्ड करें, उन खण्डों का वर्ग करके पूर्व लब्धि से गुणा करें; इस प्रकार वे पृथक्-पृथक् घटक करणियाँ प्राप्त हो जाती हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: To resolve a single compound surd into separate component surds: if the compound surd is divisible by a square, divide it; break the square root of that quotient into desired rational parts, square those parts, and multiply each by the former quotient; these yield the individual component surds.

shlokas.text: वर्ग करण्या यदि वा करण्योस्तुल्यानि रूपाण्यथवा बहूनाम् विशोधयेद् रूपकृतेः पदेन शेषस्य रूपाणि यतोनितानि ।। पृथक तदर्धे करणीद्वयं स्यान मलेऽथ बही करणी तयोर्या । रूपाणि तान्येवमतोऽपि भूयः शेषाः करण्यो यदि सन्ति वर्ग
shlokas.english: To extract the square root of a binomial or polynomial surd expression: subtract the surd (or sum of surds) from the square of the rational integer part, and take the square root of the remainder; half the rational part plus and minus this root give two surd terms of the square root. If there are multiple surds in the square, repeat this process.
shlokas.hindi: द्विपद या बहुपद करणी व्यंजक का वर्गमूल निकालने के लिए: रूप (परिमेय संख्या) के वर्ग में से करणी (या करणियों के वर्ग) को घटाकर शेषफल का वर्गमूल लें; रूप में इस वर्गमूल को जोड़ने और घटाने पर प्राप्त मानों का आधा करने से वर्गमूल के दो करणी पद बनते हैं। यदि वर्ग में अनेक करणियाँ हों तो यही प्रक्रिया बार-बार दोहराई जाती है।
shlokas.english_draft: To extract the square root of a binomial or polynomial surd expression: subtract the surd (or sum of surds) from the square of the rational integer part, and take the square root of the remainder; half the rational part plus and minus this root give two surd terms of the square root. If there are multiple surds in the square, repeat this process.

shlokas.text: ऋणात्मिका चेत् करणी कृतौ स्याद् धनात्मिका तां परिकल्प्य साध्ये । मले करण्यावनयोरभीष्टा क्षयात्मिकैका सुधियावगम्या
shlokas.english: If a negative surd is present in the square expression, treat it as positive while performing the extraction, and then knowledgeable mathematicians must assign a negative Rashi to one of the two resulting root surds as required.
shlokas.hindi: यदि वर्ग व्यंजक में कोई करणी ऋणात्मक हो, तो वर्गमूल साधते समय उसे धनात्मक मानकर हल करें; तत्पश्चात बुद्धिमान गणितज्ञ प्राप्त दोनों मूल करणियों में से आवश्यकतानुसार एक को ऋणात्मक समझें।
shlokas.english_draft: If a negative surd is present in the square expression, treat it as positive while performing the extraction, and then knowledgeable mathematicians must assign a negative sign to one of the two resulting root surds as required.

shlokas.text: अपवर्त या लब्धा मलकरण्यो भवन्ति ताश्चापि । शेषविधिना न यदि ता भवन्ति मूलं तदा तदसत्
shlokas.english: The root surds obtained after simplification by a common divisor are also valid. If they cannot be obtained through the remaining extraction procedure, then the assumed square root is invalid (impossible).
shlokas.hindi: समान अपवर्तक (साझा भाजक) से संक्षिप्त करने के उपरांत प्राप्त मूल करणियाँ भी प्रामाणिक होती हैं। यदि वे शेष वर्गमूल विधि से प्राप्त न हो सकें, तो वह कल्पित वर्गमूल असत् (असंभव) होता है।
shlokas.english_draft: The root surds obtained after simplification by a common divisor are also valid. If they cannot be obtained through the remaining extraction procedure, then the assumed square root is invalid (impossible).

shlokas.text: वर्गे यत्र करण्यो दन्तैः सिद्धर्गमिता विद्वन् । रूपैर्दशभिरूपेताः किं मूलं ब्रूहि तस्य स्यात्
shlokas.english: O learned one, tell me the square root of an expression containing 10 rational units together with the surds 32, 24, and 48 [represented by the numerical words danta (32), siddha (24), etc.].
shlokas.hindi: हे विद्वन्! 10 रूप (परिमेय इकाई) तथा दन्त (32), सिद्ध (24) और गमित/48 की करणियों से युक्त व्यंजक का वर्गमूल क्या होगा, बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: O learned one, tell me the square root of an expression containing 10 rational units together with the surds 32, 24, and 48 [represented by the numerical words danta (32), siddha (24), etc.].

shlokas.text: वर्गे यत्र करण्यास्तिथिविश्व हुताशनैश्चतुर्गणितैः । तुल्या दशरूपाढयाः किं मुलं हि तस्य स्यात्
shlokas.english: What is the square root of an expression containing 10 rational units and surds equal to 4 times 15 (60), 4 times 13 (52), and 4 times 3 (12)?
shlokas.hindi: जिस वर्ग व्यंजक में 10 रूप तथा चार से गुणित तिथि (15 × 4 = 60), विश्व (13 × 4 = 52) और हुताशन (3 × 4 = 12) के तुल्य करणियाँ हों, उसका वर्गमूल क्या होगा?
shlokas.english_draft: What is the square root of an expression containing 10 rational units and surds equal to 4 times 15 (60), 4 times 13 (52), and 4 times 3 (12)?

shlokas.text: अष्टौ षट् पञ्चाशत् षष्टिः करणीत्रयं कृतौ यत्र। रूपैदशभिरूपेतं किं मूलं ब्रूहि तस्य स्यात्
shlokas.english: Tell me the square root of an expression where the three surds are 8, 56, and 60, combined with 10 rational units.
shlokas.hindi: जिस वर्ग व्यंजक में 8, 56 तथा 60—ये तीन करणियाँ 10 रूप (इकाइयों) के साथ जुड़ी हों, उसका वर्गमूल क्या होगा, बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: Tell me the square root of an expression where the three surds are 8, 56, and 60, combined with 10 rational units.

shlokas.text: चतर्गनः सूर्यतिथीष रुद्रनागर्तवो यत्र कती करण्यः । सविश्वरूपा वद तत्पदं ते यद्यस्ति बीजे पटुताभिमानः
shlokas.english: If you take pride in your skill in algebra, tell me the square root of the expression containing surds equal to 4 times 12 (48), 15 (60), 5 (20), 11 (44), 8 (32), and 6 (24), along with 13 (Viśva) rational units.
shlokas.hindi: यदि तुम्हें बीजगणित में अपनी कुशलता का अभिमान है, तो जिस व्यंजक में 4 से गुणित सूर्य (12 × 4 = 48), तिथि (15 × 4 = 60), इषु (5 × 4 = 20), रुद्र (11 × 4 = 44), नाग (8 × 4 = 32) और ऋतु (6 × 4 = 24) की करणियाँ तथा 13 (विश्व) रूप हों, उसका वर्गमूल बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: If you take pride in your skill in algebra, tell me the square root of the expression containing surds equal to 4 times 12 (48), 15 (60), 5 (20), 11 (44), 8 (32), and 6 (24), along with 13 (Viśva) rational units.

shlokas.text: भाज्यो हारः क्षेपकश्चापवर्त्यः केनाप्यादी संभवे कुट्टकार्थम् । येन च्छिन्नौ भाज्यहारी न तेन क्षेपश्चैतद् दुष्टमुद्दिष्टमेव
shlokas.english: In the pulverizer method (Kuṭṭaka for linear indeterminate equations ax + c = by), the dividend (Bhājya), divisor (Hāra), and additive/subtractive quantity (Kṣepaka) should first be reduced by a common factor if possible. If the dividend and divisor share a common factor which does not divide the additive, the problem is defective (has no integer solution).
shlokas.hindi: कुट्टक विधि (एकघाती अनिर्धार्य समीकरण ax + c = by) में सम्भव होने पर भाज्य (a), हार/भाजक (b) तथा क्षेपक (c) को सर्वप्रथम किसी समापवर्तक (उभयनिष्ठ गुणक) से अपवर्तित (संक्षिप्त) करना चाहिए। यदि भाज्य और भाजक किसी संख्या से विभाजित होते हैं किंतु क्षेपक उससे विभाजित नहीं होता, तो वह प्रश्न दुष्ट (हल-रहित / हल असम्भव) समझना चाहिए।
shlokas.english_draft: In the pulverizer method (Kuṭṭaka for linear indeterminate equations ax + c = by), the dividend (Bhājya), divisor (Hāra), and additive/subtractive quantity (Kṣepaka) should first be reduced by a common factor if possible. If the dividend and divisor share a common factor which does not divide the additive, the problem is defective (has no integer solution).

shlokas.text: भवति कुट्टविधेर्युतिभाज्ययोः समपवर्तितयोरपि वा गुणः । भवति यो युति भाजकयोः पुनः सच भवेद अपवर्तनसंगुणः
shlokas.english: In the Kuṭṭaka process, when dividend and additive are reduced by a common factor, the multiplier obtained must be multiplied by that factor; if divisor and additive are reduced, the quotient obtained must be multiplied by that factor.
shlokas.hindi: कुट्टक विधि में यदि क्षेपक (युति) और भाज्य को समान संख्या से अपवर्तित किया गया हो, तो प्राप्त गुणक (गुण) को उस अपवर्तन संख्या से गुणा करना चाहिए। और यदि क्षेपक तथा भाजक को अपवर्तित किया गया हो, तो प्राप्त लब्धि को उस अपवर्तन संख्या से गुणा करना चाहिए।
shlokas.english_draft: In the Kuṭṭaka process, when dividend and additive are reduced by a common factor, the multiplier obtained must be multiplied by that factor; if divisor and additive are reduced, the quotient obtained must be multiplied by that factor.

shlokas.text: योगजे तक्षणाच्छद्ध गणाप्ती स्तो वियोगजे । धनभाज्योभवे तद्वद् भवेताम् ऋणभाज्यजं
shlokas.english: When the additive is positive, subtracting the resulting multiplier and quotient from their respective abraders (divisors/moduli) yields the multiplier and quotient for a negative additive, and vice versa. The same applies for positive and negative dividends.
shlokas.hindi: धनात्मक क्षेपक (योगज) से प्राप्त गुणक और लब्धि को उनके अपने-अपने तक्षणों (भाजक/मोड्युलस) में से घटाने पर ऋणात्मक क्षेपक (वियोगज) के गुणक और लब्धि प्राप्त होते हैं। इसी प्रकार धनात्मक भाज्य से प्राप्त मानों से ऋणात्मक भाज्य के मान प्राप्त होते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: When the additive is positive, subtracting the resulting multiplier and quotient from their respective abraders (divisors/moduli) yields the multiplier and quotient for a negative additive, and vice versa. The same applies for positive and negative dividends.

shlokas.text: गुणलब्ध्योः समं ग्राह्य धीमता तक्षणे फलम्
shlokas.english: A wise mathematician should take the corresponding quotient resulting from the exact same number of abrading steps (modulus reductions) used for the multiplier.
shlokas.hindi: बुद्धिमान गणितज्ञ को तक्षण (मोड्युलस घटाने) की क्रिया में गुणक और लब्धि दोनों के लिए समान संख्या में तक्षण-फल ग्रहण करना चाहिए।
shlokas.english_draft: A wise mathematician should take the corresponding quotient resulting from the exact same number of abrading steps (modulus reductions) used for the multiplier.

shlokas.text: हरतष्टे धनक्षेपे गुणलब्धी तु पूर्ववत्।। क्षेपतक्षणलाभाढया लन्धिः शुद्धौ तु वजिता
shlokas.english: When the positive additive is reduced by the divisor, multiplier and quotient are found as before; but the quotient must be increased by the integer quotient of the additive divided by the divisor (and decreased in case of subtraction/negative additive).
shlokas.hindi: जब धनात्मक क्षेपक को हार (भाजक) से तष्ट (संक्षिप्त) किया जाता है, तो गुणक और लब्धि पूर्ववत् ही प्राप्त होते हैं; किंतु लब्धि में क्षेपक के तक्षण से प्राप्त लब्धि (पूर्णांक भागफल) को जोड़ना पड़ता है, तथा विशुद्धि (ऋणात्मक क्षेपक) की स्थिति में उसे घटाना पड़ता है।
shlokas.english_draft: When the positive additive is reduced by the divisor, multiplier and quotient are found as before; but the quotient must be increased by the integer quotient of the additive divided by the divisor (and decreased in case of subtraction/negative additive).

shlokas.text: अथवा भागहारेण तष्टयोः क्षेपभाज्ययोः। गुणः प्राग्वत् ततो लन्धिर भाज्यात युतोद् धृतात्
shlokas.english: Or, when dividend and additive are both reduced by the divisor, the multiplier is found as before, and the quotient is obtained by evaluating (ax + c) / b.
shlokas.hindi: अथवा भाज्य और क्षेपक दोनों को भागहार (भाजक) से तष्ट (संक्षिप्त) कर देने पर गुणक पूर्ववत् प्राप्त होता है, और उसके बाद भाज्य में गुणक से गुणा करके क्षेपक जोड़कर भाजक से भाग देने पर लब्धि प्राप्त हो जाती है।
shlokas.english_draft: Or, when dividend and additive are both reduced by the divisor, the multiplier is found as before, and the quotient is obtained by evaluating (ax + c) / b.

shlokas.text: इष्टाहतस्वस्वहरेण युक्त ते वा भवेतां बहुधा गुणाप्ती
shlokas.english: By adding any desired integer multiple of their respective divisors (moduli) to the multiplier and quotient, infinitely many solutions for the multiplier and quotient are generated.
shlokas.hindi: गुणक और लब्धि में उनके अपने-अपने हरों (भाजकों/तक्षणों) के इच्छित गुणांक जोड़ने से अनन्त प्रकार से गुणक और लब्धि (अनेक हल) प्राप्त हो सकते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: By adding any desired integer multiple of their respective divisors (moduli) to the multiplier and quotient, infinitely many solutions for the multiplier and quotient are generated.

shlokas.text: एकविंशतियुतं शतद्वयं यद्गुणं गणक पञ्चषष्टियक । पञ्चवजितशतद्वयोद्धृतं शुद्धिमेति गुणकं वदाऽऽशु तम्
shlokas.english: O mathematician, tell me quickly the multiplier which, when multiplied by 221 and increased by 65, becomes divisible by 195 without remainder.
shlokas.hindi: हे गणक! वह गुणक शीघ्र बताओ जिसे 221 से गुणा करके 65 जोड़ने पर प्राप्त संख्या 195 से निश्शेष विभाजित हो जाती है।
shlokas.english_draft: O mathematician, tell me quickly the multiplier which, when multiplied by 221 and increased by 65, becomes divisible by 195 without remainder.

shlokas.text: यद् गुणाक्षयगषष्टिरन्विता वर्जिता च यदि वा त्रिभिस्ततः। स्यात् त्रयोदशहता निरनका तं गुणं गणक मे पृथग् बद
shlokas.english: O mathematician, tell me separately the multiplier which, when multiplying negative 60 and increased or decreased by 3, makes the result divisible by 13 without remainder.
shlokas.hindi: हे गणक! वह गुणक मुझे पृथक्-पृथक् बताओ जिससे ऋणात्मक 60 को गुणा करने पर, और उसमें 3 जोड़ने या 3 घटाने पर प्राप्त संख्या 13 से निश्शेष विभाजित हो जाती है।
shlokas.english_draft: O mathematician, tell me separately the multiplier which, when multiplying negative 60 and increased or decreased by 3, makes the result divisible by 13 without remainder.

shlokas.text: अष्टादश गुणाः केन दशाढ्या वा दशोनिताः। शुद्धं भागं प्रयच्छन्ति क्षयगैकादशोद्धताः
shlokas.english: By what multiplier is 18 multiplied, such that when increased by 10 or decreased by 10, it yields an exact quotient when divided by negative 11?
shlokas.hindi: 18 को किस गुणक से गुणा किया जाए कि उसमें 10 जोड़ने पर या 10 घटाने पर ऋणात्मक 11 से भाग देने पर पूरा-पूरा भाग चला जाए?
shlokas.english_draft: By what multiplier is 18 multiplied, such that when increased by 10 or decreased by 10, it yields an exact quotient when divided by negative 11?

shlokas.text: येन संगणिताः पञ्च त्रयोविंशतिसंयुताः। वर्जिता वा त्रिभिर्भक्ता निरग्राः स्युः स को गुणः
shlokas.english: By what multiplier is 5 multiplied, such that when increased by 23 or decreased by 23, it becomes exactly divisible by 3 without remainder? What is that multiplier?
shlokas.hindi: 5 को किस संख्या से गुणा करके 23 जोड़ने पर या 23 घटाने पर परिणाम 3 से निश्शेष विभाजित हो जाता है? वह गुणक क्या है?
shlokas.english_draft: By what multiplier is 5 multiplied, such that when increased by 23 or decreased by 23, it becomes exactly divisible by 3 without remainder? What is that multiplier?

shlokas.text: येन पञ्च गुणिताः खसंयुताः पञ्चषष्टिसहिताश्च तेऽथवा । स्युस्त्रयोदश हृता निरकास्तं गणं गणक कीर्तयाऽऽशु मे
shlokas.english: O mathematician, tell me quickly that multiplier by which 5 is multiplied, such that when increased by 0 or increased by 65, it becomes exactly divisible by 13 without remainder.
shlokas.hindi: हे गणक! वह गुणक मुझे शीघ्र बताओ जिससे 5 को गुणा करने पर, उसमें 0 जोड़ने पर या 65 जोड़ने पर वह 13 से निश्शेष विभाजित हो जाता है।
shlokas.english_draft: O mathematician, tell me quickly that multiplier by which 5 is multiplied, such that when increased by 0 or increased by 65, it becomes exactly divisible by 13 without remainder.

shlokas.text: क्षेपं विशुद्धि परिकल्प्य रूपं पृथक्तयोय गुणकारलब्धी। अभीप्सितक्षेपविशुद्धिनिघ्ने स्वहारतष्टे भवतस्तयोस्ते
shlokas.english: Assuming unity (1) as the positive or negative additive, find the multiplier and quotient separately; then multiply them by the desired positive or negative additive and reduce by their respective divisors (moduli) to obtain the required multiplier and quotient.
shlokas.hindi: रूप (1) को धनात्मक क्षेपक (क्षेप) अथवा ऋणात्मक क्षेपक (विशुद्धि) मानकर पृथक्-पृथक् गुणक और लब्धि ज्ञात करें; तत्पश्चात उन्हें इच्छित क्षेपक या विशुद्धि से गुणा करके अपने-अपने हार (भाजक) से तष्ट करने पर अभीष्ट गुणक और लब्धि प्राप्त होते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: Assuming unity (1) as the positive or negative additive, find the multiplier and quotient separately; then multiply them by the desired positive or negative additive and reduce by their respective divisors (moduli) to obtain the required multiplier and quotient.

shlokas.text: कल्प्याऽथ शुद्धिर्विकलावशेषं षष्टिश्च भाज्यः कुदिनानि हारः। तज्जं फलं स्युर्विकला गुणस्तु लिप्ताग्रमस्माच्च कलालवायम् । एवं तदूत्वं च तथाऽधिमासावमाग्रकाभ्यो दिवसा रवीन्द्वोः
shlokas.english: In astronomical Kuṭṭaka calculations: take the residual seconds (Vikalā-avaśeṣa) as the subtractive, 60 as dividend, and terrestrial days (Kudina) as divisor. The resulting quotient gives the seconds (Vikalā) and the multiplier gives the residual minutes (Liptāgra). Proceeding upwards similarly yields minutes, degrees, Rashis, and revolutions, as well as solar/lunar days from intercalary months and omitted lunar days.
shlokas.hindi: खगोलीय कुट्टक की गणनाओं में: विकला अवशेष को विशुद्धि (ऋणात्मक क्षेपक), 60 को भाज्य तथा कुदिन (भू-दिवस) को हार (भाजक) मानें। इससे प्राप्त लब्धि विकला होती है तथा गुणक लिप्ताग्र (कला शेष) होता है। इसी प्रकार ऊपर की ओर (उर्ध्व क्रम से) गणना करने पर कला, अंश, राशि और भगण प्राप्त होते हैं, तथा अधिकमास और अवम दिवसों के अवशेष से सूर्य व चन्द्र के दिवस प्राप्त होते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: In astronomical Kuṭṭaka calculations: take the residual seconds (Vikalā-avaśeṣa) as the subtractive, 60 as dividend, and terrestrial days (Kudina) as divisor. The resulting quotient gives the seconds (Vikalā) and the multiplier gives the residual minutes (Liptāgra). Proceeding upwards similarly yields minutes, degrees, signs, and revolutions, as well as solar/lunar days from intercalary months and omitted lunar days.

shlokas.text: एको हरश्चेद् गुणकी विभिन्नौ तदा गुणैक्यं परिकल्प्य भाज्यम् । अग्रंफ्यमनं कृत उक्तवद्यः संश्लिष्टसंज्ञः स्फुटकुट्टकोऽसी
shlokas.english: When there is a single divisor and different multipliers, take the sum of the multipliers as the dividend and the difference of the remainders as the additive; the process performed as described is called the Conjunct Pulverizer (Saṁśliṣṭa Kuṭṭaka).
shlokas.hindi: जब भाजक (हर) एक ही हो और गुणक भिन्न-भिन्न हों, तब गुणकों के योग को भाज्य तथा शेषों के अंतर को क्षेपक (धन/ऋण) मानकर पूर्वोक्त विधि से कुट्टक हल करना चाहिए। इस प्रक्रिया को 'संश्लिष्ट कुट्टक' (Conjunct Pulverizer) कहा जाता है।
shlokas.english_draft: When there is a single divisor and different multipliers, take the sum of the multipliers as the dividend and the difference of the remainders as the additive; the process performed as described is called the Conjunct Pulverizer (Saṁśliṣṭa Kuṭṭaka).

shlokas.text: कः पचनिघ्नो विहृतखिषष्टया सप्तावशेषोऽथ स एव राशिः। दशाहतः स्याद् विहृतनिषष्टया चतुर्दशाग्रो वद राशिमेनम्
shlokas.english: What number multiplied by 5 and divided by 63 leaves a remainder of 7, and when multiplied by 10 and divided by 63 leaves a remainder of 14? Tell me that number.
shlokas.hindi: वह कौन सी अज्ञात राशि है जिसे ५ से गुणा करके ६३ से भाग देने पर ७ शेष बचता है, और उसी राशि को १० से गुणा करके ६३ से भाग देने पर १४ शेष बचता है? हे गणितज्ञ, वह राशि बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: What number multiplied by 5 and divided by 63 leaves a remainder of 7, and when multiplied by 10 and divided by 63 leaves a remainder of 14? Tell me that number.

shlokas.text: इष्टं हस्वं तस्य वर्गः प्रकृत्या क्षण्णौ युक्तो वर्जिता वा स येन । मुलं दद्यात् क्षेपकं तं धनणं मलं तच्च ज्येष्ठमूलं वदन्ति
shlokas.english: In the quadratic indeterminate equation (Varga-prakṛti / Pell's equation Nx^2 + C = y^2): assume any arbitrary value for the lesser root (Kaniṣṭha-mūla x); its square multiplied by the multiplier (Prakṛti N), when added to or subtracted by a quantity C (Kṣepaka), yields a square root, which is called the greater root (Jyeṣṭha-mūla y).
shlokas.hindi: वर्गप्रकृति (द्विघात अनिर्धार्य समीकरण Nx² + C = y²) में: कनिष्ठ मूल (x) का कोई स्वेच्छ (इष्ट) मान मान लें; इसके वर्ग को प्रकृति (N, गुणक) से गुणा करके उसमें जिस संख्या C (क्षेपक) को जोड़ने (धनात्मक) या घटाने (ऋणात्मक) पर एक पूर्ण वर्गमूल प्राप्त होता है, उस C को क्षेपक कहते हैं और प्राप्त वर्गमूल को ज्येष्ठ मूल (y) कहते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: In the quadratic indeterminate equation (Varga-prakṛti / Pell's equation Nx^2 + C = y^2): assume any arbitrary value for the lesser root (Kaniṣṭha-mūla x); its square multiplied by the multiplier (Prakṛti N), when added to or subtracted by a quantity C (Kṣepaka), yields a square root, which is called the greater root (Jyeṣṭha-mūla y).

shlokas.text: इष्टवर्गप्रकृत्योर् यद् विवरं तेन वा भजेत् । द्विघ्नमिष्टं कनिष्ठं तत्पदं स्याद् पकसंयुतौ। ततो ज्येष्ठमिहानन्त्यं भावनातस्तथेष्टतः
shlokas.english: Alternatively, divide twice an arbitrary number by the difference between its square and the multiplier N; this yields the lesser root for an additive of 1. Then the greater root is found, and infinitely many roots can be generated through the principle of composition (Bhāvanā).
shlokas.hindi: अथवा, किसी स्वेच्छ (इष्ट) संख्या के दोगुने को उसके वर्ग और प्रकृति (N) के अंतर से भाग दें; यह १ धन-क्षेपक (C = +1) के लिए कनिष्ठ मूल (x) प्रदान करता है। तदनंतर ज्येष्ठ मूल (y) ज्ञात किया जाता है, तथा भावना नियम (principle of composition) के प्रयोग से अनंत मूल (हल) उत्पन्न किए जा सकते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: Alternatively, divide twice an arbitrary number by the difference between its square and the multiplier N; this yields the lesser root for an additive of 1. Then the greater root is found, and infinitely many roots can be generated through the principle of composition (Bhāvanā).

shlokas.text: को वर्गोऽष्टहतः सैकः कृतिः स्याद गणकोच्यताम् । एकादशगुणः को वा वर्गः सैकः कृतिः सखे
shlokas.english: O mathematician, tell me what square multiplied by 8 and increased by 1 becomes a square? Also, O friend, what square multiplied by 11 and increased by 1 becomes a square?
shlokas.hindi: हे गणितज्ञ! बताओ कि वह कौन सा वर्ग है जिसे ८ से गुणा करके १ जोड़ने पर पूर्ण वर्ग बन जाता है? तथा हे मित्र! वह कौन सा वर्ग है जिसे ११ से गुणा करके १ जोड़ने पर पूर्ण वर्ग प्राप्त होता है?
shlokas.english_draft: O mathematician, tell me what square multiplied by 8 and increased by 1 becomes a square? Also, O friend, what square multiplied by 11 and increased by 1 becomes a square?

shlokas.text: रूपशुखी खिलोद्दिष्टं वर्गयोगो गणो न चेत्
shlokas.english: When the subtractive is 1 (C = -1), the problem has no integer solution unless the multiplier N is the sum of two squares.
shlokas.hindi: जब ऋण-क्षेपक १ हो (C = -1), तब समीकरण का कोई पूर्णांक हल (खिलोद्दिष्ट) संभव नहीं है, जब तक कि प्रकृति (N, गुणक) दो वर्गों का योग न हो।
shlokas.english_draft: When the subtractive is 1 (C = -1), the problem has no integer solution unless the multiplier N is the sum of two squares.

shlokas.text: अखिले कृतिमूलाभ्यां द्विधा रूपं विभाजितम् । द्विधा -हस्वपदं ज्यष्टं ततो रूपविशोधने । पूर्ववद् वा प्रसाध्यते पदे रूपविशोधने
shlokas.english: When solvable, unity (1) is divided into two parts by taking square roots, yielding the lesser and greater roots for subtractive 1, from which solutions for additive 1 are derived as before.
shlokas.hindi: जब हल संभव हो, तो वर्गमूलों द्वारा इकाई (१) को दो भागों में विभाजित किया जाता है, जिससे ऋण-क्षेपक १ (C = -1) के लिए कनिष्ठ तथा ज्येष्ठ मूल प्राप्त होते हैं। तत्पश्चात पूर्ववत् भावना नियम द्वारा धन-क्षेपक १ (C = +1) के लिए मूल सिद्ध किए जाते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: When solvable, unity (1) is divided into two parts by taking square roots, yielding the lesser and greater roots for subtractive 1, from which solutions for additive 1 are derived as before.

shlokas.text: त्रयोदशगुणो वर्गो निरेकः कः कृतिर् भवेत् । को वाऽष्टगणितो वर्गो निरेको मलदो वद
shlokas.english: What square multiplied by 13 and decreased by 1 becomes a square? Also, what square multiplied by 8 and decreased by 1 yields a square root? Tell me.
shlokas.hindi: वह कौन सा वर्ग है जो १३ से गुणित होकर १ घटाने पर पूर्ण वर्ग बन जाता है? तथा वह कौन सा वर्ग है जो ८ से गुणित होकर १ घटाने पर वर्गमूल प्रदान करता है? बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: What square multiplied by 13 and decreased by 1 becomes a square? Also, what square multiplied by 8 and decreased by 1 yields a square root? Tell me.

shlokas.text: को वर्गः षडगणरुयाढयो द्वादशाढयोऽथवा कृतिः। युतो वा पञ्चसप्तत्या त्रिशत्या वा कृतिर् भवेत्
shlokas.english: What square multiplied by 6 and increased by 6, or by 12, or by 75, or by 300, becomes a perfect square?
shlokas.hindi: वह कौन सा वर्ग है जिसे ६ से गुणा करके ६ जोड़ने पर, अथवा १२, ७५, या ३०० जोड़ने पर पूर्ण वर्ग प्राप्त होता है?
shlokas.english_draft: What square multiplied by 6 and increased by 6, or by 12, or by 75, or by 300, becomes a perfect square?

shlokas.text: स्वबुद्धयैव पदे ज्ञेये बहुक्षेपविशोधने। तयोर्भावनयाऽऽनन्त्यं रूपक्षेपपदोत्थया
shlokas.english: For large additives or subtractives, the roots should be discovered by one's own intelligence; from them, infinitely many roots are produced by composition (Bhāvanā) with the roots derived for additive unity (1).
shlokas.hindi: बड़े धन-क्षेपक या ऋण-क्षेपक वाले समीकरणों में मूलों की खोज अपनी बुद्धि से करनी चाहिए; तत्पश्चात इकाई क्षेपक (C = 1) से प्राप्त मूलों के साथ भावना (समीकरण संयोजन) की क्रिया द्वारा अनंत मूल उत्पन्न किए जाते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: For large additives or subtractives, the roots should be discovered by one's own intelligence; from them, infinitely many roots are produced by composition (Bhāvanā) with the roots derived for additive unity (1).

shlokas.text: द्वात्रिंशद् गुणितो वर्गः कः सैको मृलदो वद
shlokas.english: Tell me: what square multiplied by 32 and increased by 1 gives a square root?
shlokas.hindi: बताओ: वह कौन सा वर्ग है जिसे ३२ से गुणा करने पर और १ जोड़ने पर वर्गमूल प्राप्त होता है?
shlokas.english_draft: Tell me: what square multiplied by 32 and increased by 1 gives a square root?

shlokas.text: इष्टभक्तो द्विधा क्षेप इष्टेनाढयो दलीकृतः। गुणमूळहतश्चाऽऽद्यो हस्वज्येष्ठे कमात् पदे
shlokas.english: Divide the additive into two parts using an arbitrary divisor: half the sum of the quotient and the divisor, and the first part multiplied by the root of the multiplier, yield the lesser and greater roots respectively.
shlokas.hindi: क्षेपक को स्वेच्छ (इष्ट) भागहार से विभाजित करके दो भाग करें: भागफल और भाजक के योग का आधा कनिष्ठ मूल (x) देता है, तथा प्रथम भाग को गुणक (प्रकृति) के वर्गमूल से गुणा करने पर ज्येष्ठ मूल (y) क्रमशः प्राप्त होते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: Divide the additive into two parts using an arbitrary divisor: half the sum of the quotient and the divisor, and the first part multiplied by the root of the multiplier, yield the lesser and greater roots respectively.

shlokas.text: का कृतिर् नवभिः क्षुण्णा द्विपञ्चाशद्युता कृतिः। को वा चतुर्गणो वर्गस् त्रयस्त्रिंशद्युता कृतिः
shlokas.english: What square multiplied by 9 and increased by 52 becomes a square? And what square multiplied by 4 and increased by 33 becomes a square?
shlokas.hindi: वह कौन सा वर्ग है जिसे ९ से गुणा करके ५२ जोड़ने पर पूर्ण वर्ग बनता है? और वह कौन सा वर्ग है जिसे ४ से गुणा करके ३३ जोड़ने पर पूर्ण वर्ग प्राप्त होता है?
shlokas.english_draft: What square multiplied by 9 and increased by 52 becomes a square? And what square multiplied by 4 and increased by 33 becomes a square?

shlokas.text: त्रयोदशगुणो वर्गः कस् त्रयोदशवर्जितः। त्रयोदशयुतो वा स्याद वर्ग एव निगद्यताम्
shlokas.english: Tell me what square multiplied by 13 and decreased by 13, or increased by 13, becomes a square.
shlokas.hindi: बताओ कि वह कौन सा वर्ग है जो १३ से गुणित होकर १३ घटाने पर, अथवा १३ जोड़ने पर पूर्ण वर्ग बन जाता है।
shlokas.english_draft: Tell me what square multiplied by 13 and decreased by 13, or increased by 13, becomes a square.

shlokas.text: ऋणगैः पञ्चभिः क्षुण्णः को वर्गः सैकविंशतिः । वर्गः स्याद् चद् चेद् वेत्सि क्षयगप्रकृती विधिम्
shlokas.english: If you know the method for negative multipliers (Kṣayaga-prakṛti), tell me what square multiplied by negative 5 and increased by 21 becomes a square.
shlokas.hindi: यदि तुम ऋणात्मक गुणक (क्षयग-प्रकृति) की विधि जानते हो, तो बताओ कि वह कौन सा वर्ग है जिसे ऋण ५ (-5) से गुणा करके २१ जोड़ने पर पूर्ण वर्ग प्राप्त होता है।
shlokas.english_draft: If you know the method for negative multipliers (Kṣayaga-prakṛti), tell me what square multiplied by negative 5 and increased by 21 becomes a square.

shlokas.text: एकस्य रूपत्रिशती षडश्वा अश्वा दशान्यस्य तु तुल्यमौल्याः । ऋणं तथा रूपशतं च यस्य ती तुल्यवित्ती च किमश्वमील्यम्
shlokas.english: One person has 300 units of currency and 6 horses; another has 10 horses of equal value but a debt of 100 units. If their net worths are equal, tell me what is the price of a horse.
shlokas.hindi: एक व्यक्ति के पास ३०० मुद्राएँ और ६ घोड़े हैं; दूसरे व्यक्ति के पास समान मूल्य के १० घोड़े हैं परंतु १०० मुद्राओं का ऋण (ऋणात्मक धन) है। यदि दोनों की कुल संपत्ति समान है, तो एक घोड़े का मूल्य कितना है?
shlokas.english_draft: One person has 300 units of currency and 6 horses; another has 10 horses of equal value but a debt of 100 units. If their net worths are equal, tell me what is the price of a horse.

shlokas.text: यदाद्यवित्तस्य दलं दियुक्तं तत्त त्यवित्तो यदि वा द्वितीयः। आद्यो धनेन त्रिगुणोऽन्यता वा पृथक् पृथङ् मे बद वाजिमील्यम्
shlokas.english: If half the first person's wealth plus 2 equals the second person's wealth, or if the first person's wealth is three times the second's wealth, tell me the price of a horse separately in each case.
shlokas.hindi: यदि प्रथम व्यक्ति के धन का आधा भाग २ जोड़ने पर दूसरे व्यक्ति के धन के बराबर हो, अथवा यदि प्रथम व्यक्ति का धन दूसरे व्यक्ति के धन का तीन गुना हो, तो दोनों स्थितियों में पृथक्-पृथक् घोड़े का मूल्य बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: If half the first person's wealth plus 2 equals the second person's wealth, or if the first person's wealth is three times the second's wealth, tell me the price of a horse separately in each case.

shlokas.text: माणिक्याष्टकमिन्द्रनीलदशकं मुक्ताफलानां शतं यत्ते कर्णविभूषणे समधनं क्रीतं त्वदर्थ मया। तद्रत्नत्रयमौल्यसंयुतिमितिस्त्र्यनं शताध प्रिये मौल्यं ब्रूहि पृथग्यदीह गणिते कल्पाऽसि कल्याणिनि
shlokas.english: O dear fair one, I bought for you two ear-ornaments of equal value containing 8 rubies, 10 sapphires, and 100 pearls. If the sum of the unit prices of these three gems is 3 less than half a hundred (i.e. 47), tell me the price of each gem separately if you are adept in calculation.
shlokas.hindi: हे प्रिये (कल्याणि)! मैंने तुम्हारे लिए समान मूल्य के कान के दो आभूषण खरीदे हैं जिनमें ८ माणिक्य, १० इंद्रनील (नीलम) तथा १०० मुक्ताफल (मोती) लगे हैं। यदि इन तीनों प्रकार के रत्नों के प्रति-इकाई मूल्यों का योग आधा-सौ से ३ कम (अर्थात् ४७) है, और तुम गणित में कुशल हो, तो प्रत्येक रत्न का मूल्य अलग-अलग बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: O dear fair one, I bought for you two ear-ornaments of equal value containing 8 rubies, 10 sapphires, and 100 pearls. If the sum of the unit prices of these three gems is 3 less than half a hundred (i.e. 47), tell me the price of each gem separately if you are adept in calculation.

shlokas.text: पञ्चकशतदत्तधनात्फलस्य वर्ग विशोध्य परिशिष्टम् । दत्तं दशकशतेन तुल्यः कालः फलं च तयोः
shlokas.english: A principal lent at 5 percent per month yields interest; subtracting the square of that interest leaves a remainder equal to the principal lent at 10 percent per month. If the time and interest accrued are equal in both cases, find the principal and interest.
shlokas.hindi: ५ प्रतिशत मासिक ब्याज की दर से दिए गए मूलधन से प्राप्त ब्याज के वर्ग को घटाने पर जो शेष बचता है, वह १० प्रतिशत मासिक दर पर दिए गए मूलधन के बराबर है। यदि दोनों स्थितियों में समय और अर्जित ब्याज समान हों, तो मूलधन और ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।
shlokas.english_draft: A principal lent at 5 percent per month yields interest; subtracting the square of that interest leaves a remainder equal to the principal lent at 10 percent per month. If the time and interest accrued are equal in both cases, find the principal and interest.

shlokas.text: माणिक्याष्टकमिन्द्रनीलदशक मुक्ताफलानां शतं सवज्राणि च पञ्च रत्नवणिजा याषां चतुणों धनम् । संगस्नेहवशेन ते निजधनाद् दत्त्वैकमेकं मिथो जातास्तुल्यधनाः पृथग्वद सखे तद्रत्नमील्यानि मे
shlokas.english: Four gem merchants possess 8 rubies, 10 sapphires, 100 pearls, and 5 diamonds respectively. Out of mutual affection, each gives one gem of his own to each of the other three, after which all four possess equal total wealth. O friend, tell me the prices of each of these gems.
shlokas.hindi: चार रत्न-व्यापारियों के पास क्रमशः ८ माणिक्य, १० नीलम, १०० मोती और ५ हीरे हैं। आपस में स्नेहवश, प्रत्येक व्यापारी अपने धन में से एक-एक रत्न अन्य तीनों को दे देता है, जिसके बाद चारों का कुल धन समान हो जाता है। हे मित्र, मुझे इन रत्नों में से प्रत्येक का मूल्य अलग-अलग बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: Four gem merchants possess 8 rubies, 10 sapphires, 100 pearls, and 5 diamonds respectively. Out of mutual affection, each gives one gem of his own to each of the other three, after which all four possess equal total wealth. O friend, tell me the prices of each of these gems.

shlokas.text: यत्पञ्चकद्विकचतुष्कशतेन दत्तं खण्डैस्त्रिभिनवतियुक त्रिशती धनं तत । मासेषु सप्तदशपञ्चसु तुल्यमाप्तं खण्डत्रयेऽपि सकलं वदखण्डसंख्याम्
shlokas.english: A sum of 390 units is divided into three parts and lent at monthly interest rates of 5%, 2%, and 4% for 10, 17, and 5 months respectively. If the interest accrued on all three parts is equal, state the amount of each part.
shlokas.hindi: ३९० धनराशि को तीन भागों में बाँटकर क्रमशः ५%, २% और ४% मासिक ब्याज दर पर १०, १७ और ५ महीनों के लिए उधार दिया गया। यदि तीनों भागों पर प्राप्त ब्याज समान है, तो तीनों भागों की राशि बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: A sum of 390 units is divided into three parts and lent at monthly interest rates of 5%, 2%, and 4% for 10, 17, and 5 months respectively. If the interest accrued on all three parts is equal, state the amount of each part.

shlokas.text: पुरप्रवेशे दशदो द्विसंगुणं विधाय शेषं दशभुक् च निर्गमे । ददी दशैवं नगरत्रयेऽभवत्त्रिनिघ्नमाद्यं वद तत्कियद्धनम्
shlokas.english: A traveler entering a city pays a toll of 10 units, doubles his remaining money inside, and pays 10 units upon leaving. After passing through three such cities, his initial money becomes tripled. Tell me what his original wealth was.
shlokas.hindi: एक यात्री किसी नगर में प्रवेश करते समय १० मुद्राएँ चुंगी (कर) देता है, अंदर अपने शेष धन को दोगुना करता है, और बाहर निकलते समय १० मुद्राएँ देता है। तीन ऐसे नगरों से गुजरने के बाद उसका मूल धन तीन गुना हो जाता है। बताओ कि उसका मूल धन कितना था?
shlokas.english_draft: A traveler entering a city pays a toll of 10 units, doubles his remaining money inside, and pays 10 units upon leaving. After passing through three such cities, his initial money becomes tripled. Tell me what his original wealth was.

shlokas.text: क्षिप्रंक्षिप्रभूजी ब्रजेम हि युतः सार्थोऽग्रतो यास्यति
shlokas.english: [A problem of travelers/caravans]: 'Let us travel swiftly, for the caravan ahead is moving forward...' Find the speeds and time of meeting of two moving caravans.
shlokas.hindi: [यात्रियों/सार्थवाहां का प्रश्न]: 'चलो शीघ्रता से चलें, क्योंकि आगे जाने वाला काफिला (सार्थ) आगे बढ़ रहा है...' दो गतिमान काफ़िलों की चाल तथा उनके मिलने का समय ज्ञात कीजिए।
shlokas.english_draft: [A problem of travelers/caravans]: 'Let us travel swiftly, for the caravan ahead is moving forward...' Find the speeds and time of meeting of two moving caravans.

shlokas.text: स्वार्धपञ्चाशनवमैर्युक्ताः के स्युः समास्त्रयः। अन्यांशदयहीना या षष्टिशेषाश्च ताम्वद
shlokas.english: What three numbers, when increased respectively by their half, one-fifth, and one-ninth, become equal to each other? And what three numbers, when decreased by those same fractional parts, leave a remainder of 60? Tell me.
shlokas.hindi: वे कौन सी तीन संख्याएँ हैं जिन्हें क्रमशः अपने आधे भाग (1/2), पाँचवें भाग (1/5), और नौवें भाग (1/9) से बढ़ाने पर तीनों परस्पर समान हो जाती हैं? तथा वे कौन सी तीन संख्याएँ हैं जिन्हें उन्हीं भिन्नांशों से घटाने पर ६० शेष बचता है? बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: What three numbers, when increased respectively by their half, one-fifth, and one-ninth, become equal to each other? And what three numbers, when decreased by those same fractional parts, leave a remainder of 60? Tell me.

shlokas.text: त्रयोदश तथा पञ्च करण्यौ भजयोर्मिती। भरज्ञाताऽत्र चत्वारः फलं भूमि वदाऽऽशु मे
shlokas.english: In a triangle, the two sides are surd 13 and surd 5, and the altitude is 4. Tell me quickly the area and the base of the triangle.
shlokas.hindi: एक त्रिभुज में दो भुजाएँ करणी १३ (√13) और करणी ५ (√5) हैं, तथा लंब (ऊँचाई) ४ है। मुझे शीघ्र ही त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल और आधार बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: In a triangle, the two sides are surd 13 and surd 5, and the altitude is 4. Tell me quickly the area and the base of the triangle.

shlokas.text: दशपञ्चकरण्यन्तरमेको बाहुः परश्च षट् करणी। भरष्टादश करणी रूपोना लम्बमाचक्ष्व
shlokas.english: In a triangle, one side is surd 10 minus surd 5, another side is surd 6, and the base is surd 18 minus 1 unit. State the altitude of this triangle.
shlokas.hindi: एक त्रिभुज में एक भुजा करणी १० घटा करणी ५ (√10 - √5) है, दूसरी भुजा करणी ६ (√6) है, और आधार करणी १८ घटा १ (√18 - 1) इकाई है। इस त्रिभुज की ऊँचाई (लंब) बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: In a triangle, one side is surd 10 minus surd 5, another side is surd 6, and the base is surd 18 minus 1 unit. State the altitude of this triangle.

shlokas.text: असमानसमच्छेदाराशींस्तांश्चतुरो वद । यदैकं यद्धनैक्यं वा येषां वर्गक्यसंमितम्
shlokas.english: Tell me four quantities with unequal or equal denominators such that the sum of the quantities (or sum of their cubes) equals the sum of their squares.
shlokas.hindi: असमान या समान हर (समच्छेद) वाली ऐसी चार राशियाँ बताओ जिनका योग (अथवा उनके घनों का योग) उनके वर्गों के योग के बराबर हो।
shlokas.english_draft: Tell me four quantities with unequal or equal denominators such that the sum of the quantities (or sum of their cubes) equals the sum of their squares.

shlokas.text: त्र्यस्रक्षेत्रस्य यस्य स्यात्फलं कर्णेन संमितम् । दोःकोटिश्रुतिघातेन समं यस्य च तद्वद
shlokas.english: Tell me a right-angled triangle whose area is equal to its hypotenuse, and another whose area is equal to the product of its base, perpendicular (upright), and hypotenuse.
shlokas.hindi: ऐसा समकोण त्रिभुज बताओ जिसका क्षेत्रफल उसके कर्ण के मान के बराबर हो; तथा दूसरा ऐसा समकोण त्रिभुज बताओ जिसका क्षेत्रफल उसकी भुजा (आधार), कोटि (लंब) और श्रुति (कर्ण) के गुणनफल के बराबर हो।
shlokas.english_draft: Tell me a right-angled triangle whose area is equal to its hypotenuse, and another whose area is equal to the product of its base, perpendicular (upright), and hypotenuse.

shlokas.text: ते घनो भवेत । तौ राशी शीघ्रमाचक्ष्व दक्षोऽसि गणिते यदि
shlokas.english: Tell me quickly two numbers whose sum of squares is a cube, if you are skilled in mathematics.
shlokas.hindi: यदि तुम गणित में चतुर हो, तो शीघ्र ही ऐसी दो राशियाँ बताओ जिनके वर्गों का योग एक पूर्ण घन हो।
shlokas.english_draft: Tell me quickly two numbers whose sum of squares is a cube, if you are skilled in mathematics.

shlokas.text: घनैक्यं जायते वर्गों वर्गक्यं च ययोर्धनः। ती चेदेसि तदाऽहं स्वां मन्ये बीजविदां वरम्
shlokas.english: If you know two numbers whose sum of cubes is a square, and whose sum of squares is a cube, then I consider you to be the foremost among experts in algebra!
shlokas.hindi: यदि तुम ऐसी दो राशियों को जानते हो जिनके घनों का योग एक वर्ग हो, और जिनके वर्गों का योग एक घन हो, तो मैं तुम्हें बीजगणित के विद्वानों में श्रेष्ठ मानता हूँ!
shlokas.english_draft: If you know two numbers whose sum of cubes is a square, and whose sum of squares is a cube, then I consider you to be the foremost among experts in algebra!

shlokas.text: यत्र यो क्षेत्रे धात्री मनुसंमिता सखे बाहू । एकः पञ्चदशान्यस्त्रयोदश क्दावलम्बकं तत्र
shlokas.english: O friend, in a triangle where the base is 14 (Manu) units, and the two sides are 15 and 13 units, what is the altitude (perpendicular height)?
shlokas.hindi: हे मित्र! उस त्रिभुज में जहाँ आधार १४ (मनु संख्या) इकाई है, और दो भुजाएँ १५ तथा १३ इकाई हैं, लंब (ऊँचाई) क्या होगी?
shlokas.english_draft: O friend, in a triangle where the base is 14 (Manu) units, and the two sides are 15 and 13 units, what is the altitude (perpendicular height)?

shlokas.text: यदि समभुवि वेणुद्धित्रिपाणिप्रमाणो गणक पवनवेगादेकदेशे स भग्नः। भुवि नृपमितहस्तेष्वग लग्नं तदनम् कथय कतिषु मलादेष भग्नः करेषु
shlokas.english: O mathematician, if a bamboo of height 32 cubits standing on level ground is broken by the force of wind at some height, and its tip touches the ground at a distance of 16 (Nṛpa) cubits from the base, tell me at what height from the base it broke.
shlokas.hindi: हे गणितज्ञ! यदि समतल भूमि पर खड़ा ३२ हाथ ऊँचा एक बाँस वायु के वेग से किसी स्थान से टूट जाता है, और उसका अग्रभाग जड़ से १६ (नृप) हाथ की दूरी पर भूमि को स्पर्श करता है, तो बताओ कि वह जड़ से कितने हाथ की ऊँचाई पर टूटा?
shlokas.english_draft: O mathematician, if a bamboo of height 32 cubits standing on level ground is broken by the force of wind at some height, and its tip touches the ground at a distance of 16 (Nṛpa) cubits from the base, tell me at what height from the base it broke.

shlokas.text: चक्रक्रौंचाकुलितसलिले क्वापि दृष्टं तडागे तोयादृध्वं कमलकलिकाग्रं वितस्तिप्रमाणम् ।मन्दं मन्दं चलितमनिलेनाहतं हस्तयुग्मे - तस्मिन्मग्नं गणक कथय क्षिप्रमम्बप्रमाणम्
shlokas.english: In a pond frequented by ducks and cranes, the tip of a lotus bud was seen rising 1 span (half a cubit) above the water. Blown gently by the wind, it became submerged in the water at a distance of 2 cubits from its original position. O mathematician, tell me quickly the depth of the water.
shlokas.hindi: बत्तखों और सारसों से सुशोभित एक तालाब में, एक कमल की कली का अग्रभाग जल के ऊपर १ बित्ता (आधा हाथ) ऊँचा दिखाई दे रहा था। पवन के झोंके से धीरे-धीरे झुककर वह अपने स्थान से २ हाथ की दूरी पर जल में डूब गया। हे गणितज्ञ, शीघ्र बताओ कि जल की गहराई कितनी है?
shlokas.english_draft: In a pond frequented by ducks and cranes, the tip of a lotus bud was seen rising 1 span (half a cubit) above the water. Blown gently by the wind, it became submerged in the water at a distance of 2 cubits from its original position. O mathematician, tell me quickly the depth of the water.

shlokas.text: वृक्षाद्धस्तशतोच्छ्याच्छतयुगे वापी कपिः कोऽप्यगाद् उत्तीर्याथ परो द्रुतं श्रुतिपथात्प्रोड्डीय किंचिद्रमात् । जातवं समता तयोर्यदि गतावड़ीयमानं कियद विद्रुश्चेत्सुपरिश्रमोऽस्ति गणिते क्षिप्रं तदाचक्ष्व मे
shlokas.english: From a tree 100 cubits high, at whose base lies a well 200 cubits away, one monkey climbs down and walks to the well, while another monkey leaps up into the air and flies hypotenusally directly to the well. If the total distances traveled by both monkeys are equal, tell me quickly how high the second monkey leaped up.
shlokas.hindi: १०० हाथ ऊँचे एक वृक्ष से, जिसके आधार से २०० हाथ दूर एक कुआँ है, एक बंदर नीचे उतरकर कुएँ तक पैदल जाता है, जबकि दूसरा बंदर हवा में कुछ ऊँचाई तक उछलकर कर्णमार्ग (सीधे रेखा) से कुएँ पर पहुँचता है। यदि दोनों द्वारा तय की गई कुल दूरी समान है, और गणित में तुम्हारा अच्छा परिश्रम है, तो शीघ्र बताओ कि दूसरा बंदर कितनी ऊँचाई तक उछला था?
shlokas.english_draft: From a tree 100 cubits high, at whose base lies a well 200 cubits away, one monkey climbs down and walks to the well, while another monkey leaps up into the air and flies hypotenusally directly to the well. If the total distances traveled by both monkeys are equal, tell me quickly how high the second monkey leaped up.

shlokas.text: पञ्चदशदशकरोच्छायवेण्वोरज्ञातमध्यभूमिकयोः । इतरेतरमूलाग्रगसूत्रयुतेर्लम्बमानमाचक्ष्व
shlokas.english: Two bamboos of heights 15 cubits and 10 cubits stand upright at an unknown distance apart. Threads are tied from the top of each bamboo to the base of the other. State the height above the ground of the intersection point of these two threads.
shlokas.hindi: १५ हाथ तथा १० हाथ ऊँचाई के दो बाँस अज्ञात दूरी पर सीधे खड़े हैं। प्रत्येक बाँस के शीर्ष से दूसरे के आधार तक धागे बाँधे गए हैं। इन दोनों धागों के प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदु की भूमि से ऊँचाई (लंब) ज्ञात कीजिए।
shlokas.english_draft: Two bamboos of heights 15 cubits and 10 cubits stand upright at an unknown distance apart. Threads are tied from the top of each bamboo to the base of the other. State the height above the ground of the intersection point of these two threads.

shlokas.text: अत्यक्तमूलर्णगरूपतोऽल्पं व्यक्तस्य पक्षस्य पदं यदि स्यात् । ऋणं धनं तव विधाय साध्यमव्यक्तमानं द्विविध क्वचित्तत्
shlokas.english: When the square root of the absolute/known side is less than the negative constant term on the unknown side, making the root either positive or negative yields two distinct valid values for the unknown quantity.
shlokas.hindi: जब व्यक्त (अचर) पक्ष का वर्गमूल अज्ञात पक्ष के ऋणात्मक पद से कम होता है, तो वर्गमूल को धनात्मक या ऋणात्मक मानकर अज्ञात राशि के दो भिन्न वैध मान सिद्ध किए जाते हैं।
shlokas.english_draft: When the square root of the absolute/known side is less than the negative constant term on the unknown side, making the root either positive or negative yields two distinct valid values for the unknown quantity.

shlokas.text: चतुराहतवर्गसमै रूपैः पक्षद्वयं गुणयेत । पूर्वाव्यक्तस्य कृतेः समरूपाणि क्षिपेत्तयोरेव' इति
shlokas.english: Multiply both sides of the equation by four times the coefficient of the square of the unknown, and add to both sides the square of the original coefficient of the unknown (the method of elimination of middle term / Sreedharacarya's rule).
shlokas.hindi: समीकरण के दोनों पक्षों को अज्ञात के वर्ग के गुणांक के चार गुने से गुणा करें, और दोनों पक्षों में अज्ञात के मूल गुणांक के वर्ग को जोड़ें (मध्यम पद का लोप करने की श्रीधराचार्य विधि)।
shlokas.english_draft: Multiply both sides of the equation by four times the coefficient of the square of the unknown, and add to both sides the square of the original coefficient of the unknown (the method of elimination of middle term / Sreedharacarya's rule).

shlokas.text: अलिकुलदलमूलं मालती यातमष्टौ निखिलनवमभागाश्चालिनी भंगमेकम्। निशि परिमललुब्धं पद्ममध्ये निरुद्धम् प्रतिरणति रणन्तं हि कान्तेऽलिसंख्याम्
shlokas.english: O dear one, half the square root of a swarm of bees flew to a Mālatī jasmine tree; eight-ninths of the whole swarm also went there; one female bee was hovering around a male bee trapped inside a lotus blossom at night, attracted by its fragrance, responding to his humming. Tell me the total number of bees in the swarm.
shlokas.hindi: हे काँते (प्रिये)! भौंरों के एक समूह के वर्गमूल का आधा भाग मालती के वृक्ष पर चला गया; संपूर्ण समूह का आठ-नौवाँ (8/9) भाग भी वहीं गया; तथा रात्रि में सुगंध से लुब्ध होकर कमल के फूल में बंद गुंजन करते हुए एक नर भौंरे के चारों ओर एक मादा भौंरी गुंजन कर रही थी। भौंरों के कुल समूह की संख्या बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: O dear one, half the square root of a swarm of bees flew to a Mālatī jasmine tree; eight-ninths of the whole swarm also went there; one female bee was hovering around a male bee trapped inside a lotus blossom at night, attracted by its fragrance, responding to his humming. Tell me the total number of bees in the swarm.

shlokas.text: पार्थः कर्णवधाय मार्गणगणं ऋद्धो रणे संदधे तस्यार्धन निवार्य तच्छरगणं मूलश्चतुभिहयान् । । शल्यं पड्भिरथेषुभिस्त्रिभिरपि च्छत्रं ध्वजं कार्मुकं चिच्छेदास्य शिरः शरेण कति ते यानर्जुनः संदधे
shlokas.english: In battle, enraged Arjuna shot a volley of arrows to kill Karṇa: with half of them he parried Karṇa's arrows; with four times the square root of the total he killed his horses; with six arrows he slew Śalya; with three arrows he destroyed the umbrella, banner, and bow; and with one arrow he severed Karṇa's head. How many arrows did Arjuna shoot in total?
shlokas.hindi: युद्ध में क्रुद्ध अर्जुन ने कर्ण के वध हेतु बाणों का एक समूह संधान किया: आधे बाणों से उसने कर्ण के बाणों को काटा; कुल बाणों के वर्गमूल के चार गुने बाणों से उसके घोड़ों को मारा; ६ बाणों से शल्य का वध किया; ३ बाणों से छत्र, ध्वज और धनुष काटे; तथा १ बाण से कर्ण का सिर काट डाला। अर्जुन ने कुल कितने बाण चलाए थे?
shlokas.english_draft: In battle, enraged Arjuna shot a volley of arrows to kill Karṇa: with half of them he parried Karṇa's arrows; with four times the square root of the total he killed his horses; with six arrows he slew Śalya; with three arrows he destroyed the umbrella, banner, and bow; and with one arrow he severed Karṇa's head. How many arrows did Arjuna shoot in total?

shlokas.text: व्येकस्य गच्छस्य दलं किलादिरादेर्दलं तत्प्रचयः फलं च । चयादिगच्छामिहतिः स्वसप्तभागाधिका बेहि चयादिगच्छान्
shlokas.english: In an arithmetic progression, the first term (Ādi) is half of the number of terms (Gaccha) minus one; the common difference (Pracaya) is half the first term; and the sum (Phala) is equal to the product of common difference, first term, and number of terms increased by one-seventh of itself. Find the first term, common difference, and number of terms.
shlokas.hindi: एक समांतर श्रेणी में, प्रथम पद (आदि) पदों की संख्या (गच्छ) में से १ घटाकर उसका आधा है; सार्व अंतर (प्रचय) प्रथम पद का आधा है; और योगफल (फल) सार्व अंतर, प्रथम पद और गच्छ के गुणनफल के अपने ही सातवें भाग से अधिक होने के बराबर है। प्रथम पद, सार्व अंतर और गच्छ ज्ञात कीजिए।
shlokas.english_draft: In an arithmetic progression, the first term (Ādi) is half of the number of terms (Gaccha) minus one; the common difference (Pracaya) is half the first term; and the sum (Phala) is equal to the product of common difference, first term, and number of terms increased by one-seventh of itself. Find the first term, common difference, and number of terms.

shlokas.text: कः खेन विहृतो राशिः कोट्या युक्तोऽथवोनितः । वर्गितः स्वपदेनाऽऽढयः खगुणो नवतिर्भवेत्
shlokas.english: What number divided by zero, when increased or decreased by ten million (10^7), then squared, added to its own square root, and multiplied by zero, becomes 90?
shlokas.hindi: वह कौन सी राशि है जिसे शून्य से भाग देने पर, फिर उसमें १ करोड़ (10⁷) जोड़ने या घटाने पर, वर्ग करने पर, उसमें अपना ही वर्गमूल जोड़ने पर, और शून्य से गुणा करने पर मान ९० हो जाता है?
shlokas.english_draft: What number divided by zero, when increased or decreased by ten million (10^7), then squared, added to its own square root, and multiplied by zero, becomes 90?

shlokas.text: कः स्वार्धसहितो राशिः खगुणो वर्गितो युतः । स्वपदाभ्यां खभक्तश्च जातः पञ्चदशीच्यताम्
shlokas.english: What number, when increased by its own half, multiplied by zero, squared, added to twice its square root, and divided by zero, yields 15? Tell me.
shlokas.hindi: वह कौन सी राशि है जिसे अपने आधे भाग से बढ़ाने पर, शून्य से गुणा करने पर, वर्ग करने पर, उसके वर्गमूल के दोगुने को जोड़ने पर, और शून्य से भाग देने पर १५ प्राप्त होता है? बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: What number, when increased by its own half, multiplied by zero, squared, added to twice its square root, and divided by zero, yields 15? Tell me.

shlokas.text: राशिर्वादशनिघ्नो राशिघनाढयश्च कः समो यस्य । राशिकृतिः षड्गुणिता पञ्चत्रिंशद्युता विद्वन्
shlokas.english: O learned one, what number multiplied by 12 and added to its cube is equal to 6 times its square plus 35?
shlokas.hindi: हे विद्वन्! वह कौन सी राशि है जिसे १२ से गुणा करके उसके घन में जोड़ने पर, मान उसके वर्ग के ६ गुने तथा ३५ के योग के बराबर होता है? (x³ + 12x = 6x² + 35)
shlokas.english_draft: O learned one, what number multiplied by 12 and added to its cube is equal to 6 times its square plus 35?

shlokas.text: को राशिदिशतीक्षण्णो राशिवर्गयुतो हतः। द्वाभ्यां तेनोनितो राशिवर्गवोऽयुतं भवेत् । रूपोनं वद तं राशि वेत्सि बीजक्रियां यदि
shlokas.english: If you know algebraic procedures, tell me what number multiplied by 10, added to its square, multiplied by 2, and subtracted from its square-square (x^4), equals 10,000 minus 1 (i.e. 9,999).
shlokas.hindi: यदि तुम बीजगणित की क्रिया जानते हो, तो बताओ कि वह कौन सी राशि है जिसे १० से गुणा करके, उसके वर्ग में जोड़कर, २ से गुणा करने पर, और उसे उसके वर्ग-वर्ग (x⁴) में से घटाने पर १०,००० घटा १ (अर्थात् ९,९९९) प्राप्त होता है?
shlokas.english_draft: If you know algebraic procedures, tell me what number multiplied by 10, added to its square, multiplied by 2, and subtracted from its square-square (x^4), equals 10,000 minus 1 (i.e. 9,999).

shlokas.text: चनान्तराले प्लवगाष्टभागः संवर्गितो वलाति जातरागः । व्रत्कारनादप्रतिनादहृष्टा दृष्टा गिरौ द्वादश ते कियन्तः
shlokas.english: In a forest, one-eighth of a troop of monkeys squared were frolicking with great delight; 12 remaining monkeys were seen on a hill enjoying the echoes of their own chatter. How many monkeys were there in total?
shlokas.hindi: एक वन में वानरों के समूह के आठवें भाग का वर्ग अत्यंत आनंद से क्रीड़ा कर रहा था; और शेष १२ वानर पहाड़ी पर अपने ही कोलाहल की प्रतिध्वनि का आनंद लेते हुए देखे गए। कुल मिलाकर कितने वानर थे?
shlokas.english_draft: In a forest, one-eighth of a troop of monkeys squared were frolicking with great delight; 12 remaining monkeys were seen on a hill enjoying the echoes of their own chatter. How many monkeys were there in total?

shlokas.text: यथात् पञ्चांशकस्म्यूनो वर्गितो गहरं गतः। दृष्टः शाखामृगः शाखामारूढो वद ते कति ॥ कर्णस्य त्रिलवेनोना द्वादशाङ्गुलशंकुभा।। चतुर्दशाङ्गुला जाता गणक ब्रूहि तां द्रुतम्
shlokas.english: A troop of monkeys minus its one-fifth part squared went into a cave, and 1 monkey was seen perched on a branch; tell me how many monkeys there were. Also, a 12-digit gnomon shadow decreased by one-third of the hypotenuse becomes 14 digits; O mathematician, find the shadow length quickly.
shlokas.hindi: वानरों के एक दल में से उसके पाँचवें भाग को घटाकर बची संख्या का वर्ग गुफा में चला गया, और १ वानर पेड़ की शाखा पर बैठा हुआ देखा गया; बताओ कुल कितने वानर थे? तथा, १२-अंगुल शंकोः की छाया अपने कर्ण के तिहाई भाग से कम होकर १४ अंगुल हो जाती है; हे गणितज्ञ, शीघ्र उस छाया की लंबाई बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: A troop of monkeys minus its one-fifth part squared went into a cave, and 1 monkey was seen perched on a branch; tell me how many monkeys there were. Also, a 12-digit gnomon shadow decreased by one-third of the hypotenuse becomes 14 digits; O mathematician, find the shadow length quickly.

shlokas.text: चत्वारो राशयः के ते मूलदा ये द्विसंयुताः । हूयोर्द्वयोर्यथासन्नधाताश्चाष्टादशान्विताः ।। मूलदाः सर्वमलेक्यादेकादशयुतात्पदम् । त्रयोदश सखे जातं बीजज्ञ वद तान्मम
shlokas.english: O expert in algebra, tell me what four numbers are such that each increased by 2 gives a square root; the product of any two adjacent numbers increased by 18 gives a square root; and the square root of the sum of all their roots increased by 11 equals 13.
shlokas.hindi: हे बीजगणितज्ञ! बताओ कि वे चार राशियाँ कौन सी हैं जिनमें से प्रत्येक में २ जोड़ने पर वर्गमूल प्राप्त होता है; किन्हीं भी दो निकटवर्ती राशियों के गुणनफल में १८ जोड़ने पर वर्गमूल प्राप्त होता है; और उन सभी के वर्गमूलों के योग में ११ जोड़ने पर उसका वर्गमूल १३ प्राप्त होता है?
shlokas.english_draft: O expert in algebra, tell me what four numbers are such that each increased by 2 gives a square root; the product of any two adjacent numbers increased by 18 gives a square root; and the square root of the sum of all their roots increased by 11 equals 13.

shlokas.text: राशिक्षेपाद्वधक्षेपो यद्गुणस्तत्पदोत्तरम् ।। अव्यक्तराशयः कल्प्या वगिताः क्षेपवर्जिताः
shlokas.english: Rule for solving multiple equations involving unknown quantities, squares, products, and additives.
shlokas.hindi: अज्ञात राशियों, उनके वर्गों, गुणनफलों और क्षेपकों से युक्त बहु-समीकरणों को हल करने का नियम।
shlokas.english_draft: Rule for solving multiple equations involving unknown quantities, squares, products, and additives.

shlokas.text: दो कोटयन्तरवर्गण द्विघ्नः घातः समन्वितः। वर्गयोगसमः स स्याद्वयोरव्यक्तयोर्यथा
shlokas.english: Twice the product of two unknown quantities added to the square of their difference is equal to the sum of their squares, i.e., 2xy + (x-y)^2 = x^2 + y^2.
shlokas.hindi: दो अज्ञात राशियों के गुणनफल का दोगुना उनके अंतर के वर्ग में जोड़ने पर, उनके वर्गों के योग के बराबर होता है, अर्थात् 2xy + (x-y)² = x² + y²।
shlokas.english_draft: Twice the product of two unknown quantities added to the square of their difference is equal to the sum of their squares, i.e., 2xy + (x-y)^2 = x^2 + y^2.

shlokas.text: भुजात्यनात्पदं व्यकं कोटिकर्णान्तरं सखे । यत्र तत्र वद क्षेत्र दो-कोटिश्रवणान्मम
shlokas.english: O friend, in any right triangle where the upright minus the base yields a known square root, and the difference between hypotenuse and upright is given, state the base, upright, and hypotenuse.
shlokas.hindi: हे मित्र! किसी भी ऐसे समकोण त्रिभुज में जहाँ कोटि (लंब) और भुज (आधार) का अंतर एक ज्ञात वर्गमूल देता है, तथा कर्ण और कोटि (लंब) का अंतर दिया गया हो, मुझे भुज, कोटि और कर्ण के मान बताओ।
shlokas.english_draft: O friend, in any right triangle where the upright minus the base yields a known square root, and the difference between hypotenuse and upright is given, state the base, upright, and hypotenuse.

shlokas.text: वर्गयोगस्य यद्राश्योयुतिवर्गस्य चान्तरम् । द्विघ्नघातसमानं स्याद्वयोरव्यक्तयोर्यथा ॥ चतुर्गणस्य घातस्य युतिवर्गस्य चान्तरम् । राश्यन्तरकतेस्तुल्यं द्वयोरव्यक्तयोर्यथा
